scripts.build: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'tsc -b && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension "$@"' --
scripts.check: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test "$@"' --
scripts.dev:setup: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'npm run db:start && npm run db:migrate "$@"' --
scripts.dev:api: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'tsc -b apps/api --pretty false && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/api/src/server.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:extension:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/i EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43110 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43101 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/i npm run test:browser -w @job-hunter-v2/extension "$@"' --
scripts.test:field-intelligence:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/j EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43210 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43201 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/j node --import tsx scripts/phase-j-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:ai:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'npm run typecheck && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/p EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43210 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43201 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/p PHASE_P_BROWSER=true node --import tsx scripts/phase-j-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:execution:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/k EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43310 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43301 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/k node --import tsx scripts/phase-k-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:strategy:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/q EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43310 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43301 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/q PHASE_Q_BROWSER=true node --import tsx scripts/phase-k-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:strategy:offline: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'npm run typecheck && node --import tsx scripts/phase-q-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:autofill:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'AUTOFILL_SMOKE=true npm run test:execution:browser "$@"' --
scripts.test:admin: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'tsc -b apps/api --pretty false && node --import tsx --test apps/api/src/admin.test.ts'
scripts.test:admin:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'tsc -b apps/api apps/web --pretty false && node --import tsx scripts/admin-browser-smoke.ts'
scripts.test:form-graph:browser: bash scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/n EXTENSION_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43310 EXTENSION_WEB_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:43301 EXTENSION_CHANNEL=development npm run build:extension && EXTENSION_OUTPUT_DIR=.local-data/extension-test/n node --import tsx scripts/phase-k-browser-smoke.ts "$@"' --
